```{=html}
<p class="mission reveal">GAIA Lab develops
<em class="mark">machine learning</em> methods that turn satellite imagery and
climate data into verifiable information about <em class="mark">forests</em>,
<em class="mark">agriculture</em> and <em class="mark">climate</em>. Created in
2024 at FGV EMAp, the lab works at territorial scale, across five Brazilian
states, and checks every result against official references.</p>

<div class="stats reveal">
  <div><div class="stat-num" data-count="22">0</div><div class="stat-label">Researchers</div></div>
```

## Our history

```{=html}
<div class="timeline">
  <div class="tl-item reveal">
    <div class="tl-year">2024</div>
    <div class="tl-text">The lab is created at FGV EMAp, in Rio de Janeiro, bringing together machine learning research applied to Earth observation.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="tl-item reveal">
    <div class="tl-year">2025</div>
    <div class="tl-text">Build of our own plot level base and of the vegetation index series: 359,600 plots across 897 municipalities in five states, covering 2020 to 2025.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="tl-item reveal">
    <div class="tl-year">2025</div>
    <div class="tl-text">Team at the 14th International Conference on Climate Informatics, in April, and the first forest segmentation models with Sentinel-2 imagery from the Brazil Data Cube.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="tl-item reveal">
    <div class="tl-year">2026</div>
    <div class="tl-text">Forest product at scale, with 26 quarterly maps delivered from 2020 to 2026 and validation against INPE's DETER alerts and PRODES polygons.</div>
  </div>
</div>
```

## How we work

```{=html}
<div class="hscroll-wrap reveal">
  <button class="hscroll-btn prev" aria-label="Previous"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M15 5l-7 7 7 7"/></svg></button>
  <div class="hscroll">
    <article class="hs-card"><div class="hs-kicker">Principle 01</div><div class="hs-title">Reproducible science</div><div class="hs-text">The same run, repeated, varies by up to ±0.0076 IoU. Every result comes with that margin stated.</div></article>
    <article class="hs-card"><div class="hs-kicker">Principle 02</div><div class="hs-title">Validation against official references</div><div class="hs-text">Each product is compared with DETER, PRODES, ZARC, MapBiomas and the Rural Environmental Registry.</div></article>
    <article class="hs-card"><div class="hs-kicker">Principle 03</div><div class="hs-title">Territorial scale</div><div class="hs-text">359,600 plots, 897 municipalities and five states, with series from 2020 to 2025.</div></article>
    <article class="hs-card"><div class="hs-kicker">Principle 04</div><div class="hs-title">Transparency about limits</div><div class="hs-text">We publish where the model fails. Validated against DETER alerts, recall for the forest class is 0.28.</div></article>
  </div>
  <button class="hscroll-btn next" aria-label="Next"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="m9 5 7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
</div>
```
